facts.text: The repository contains standalone scripts for the Keithley 2400, 2450 and 2657A source-measure units
The 2450 script opens the first USB VISA resource as the module-level object keithley
The 2450 script queries *IDN? after opening the resource
The 2450 script configures current source mode with smu.source.func = smu.FUNC_DC_CURRENT, smu.source.level and smu.source.vlimit.level
The 2450 script configures voltage source mode with smu.source.func = smu.FUNC_DC_VOLTAGE, smu.source.level and smu.source.ilimit.level
The 2450 script turns the source output on with smu.source.output = smu.ON
The 2450 script sets the source level to zero and waits soak_time before writing smu.source.output = smu.OFF
The 2450 script reads a voltage measurement by setting smu.measure.func to smu.FUNC_DC_VOLTAGE and calling smu.measure.read on a source buffer
The 2450 script reads a current measurement by setting smu.measure.func to smu.FUNC_DC_CURRENT and calling smu.measure.read on a source buffer
The 2450 script creates a source buffer with buffer.make(buffer_size) before measuring
The README names PyVISA as the connection library for the 2450 and 2657A and PyMeasure for the 2400

operator_required.name: source_current
operator_required.reason: the clone writes smu.source.level with the value of its input parameter and states no current range (Keithley_control_2450.py:56-63); the operator must supply the source-current envelope

operator_required.name: compliance_voltage
operator_required.reason: the clone sets smu.source.vlimit.level from its voltage_limit parameter and states no compliance range (Keithley_control_2450.py:61-63); the operator must supply the compliance envelope

safe_state.description: source output disabled and the source level set to zero
